name: table
label: Table
description: If the content to render is a record, the table of the record

name: sys_id
label: Sys Id
description: If the content to render is a record, the sys id of the record

name: parent_table
label: Parent Table
description: The table of the parent record

name: parent_sys_id
label: Parent Sys Id
description: The sys id of the parent record

name: renderer_type
label: Renderer Type
description: Default is record. For typed renderers (non-record), it can be a custom string

name: params
label: Params
description: Properties passed to the component rendering the content

name: path
label: Path
description: Hierarchy support for breadcrumb navigation. Objects in the list have the same shape as rest of the payload

name: multiInstField
label: Multi instance field
description: Field that is used in conjunction with route, params to support multiple instance of a content

name: query
label: Query
description: Additional data passed to the component
